task_summary: Installed modern-web-guidance and reworked BukSU CMS-V2 UI across shell, dashboards, and all Student, Instructor, and Faculty (Adviser, Panelist, Secretary) pages around shared PageHeader, MetricGrid, StatCard, SectionHeader, and FilterToolbar primitives with token-safe light/dark themes and zero horizontal overflow.
key_decisions: Unified every workspace page on five reusable layout primitives under client/src/components/common/ (PageHeader with single h1 + eyebrow + description + actions, MetricGrid, StatCard, SectionHeader, FilterToolbar) inside DashboardLayout's uniform max-w-7xl container, including the remaining 9 secondary pages and empty/error states in ChapterUploadPage and ProposalCompilationPage.

Applied modern-web-guidance patterns (accessibility, improve-text-layout-and-legibility, breadcrumbs, form-factor-adaptation): semantic <nav aria-label='Breadcrumbs'><ol> with aria-current='page', h1..h3 text-wrap: balance, responsive img/video bounds, and body overflow-wrap: break-word paired with whitespace-nowrap on TextScaleDropdown.

Built dual-format skill library .agents/skills/cms-ui-consistency-library/ (SKILL.md, library.json, role-page-matrix.json, mwg-rules.json, and concise references/) for low-context consumption without degradation.
lessons_learned: Lesson learned: Applying overflow-wrap: anywhere globally on body caused compact flex controls like TextScaleDropdown ('100%') and mobile breadcrumbs ('Compilation') to break mid-token; use overflow-wrap: break-word on body plus explicit whitespace-nowrap on numeric triggers and [overflow-wrap:anywhere] only on arbitrary user strings/hashes.

Lesson learned: Student pages without an active project (ChapterUploadPage, ProposalCompilationPage) bypassed PageHeader in early returns, leaving h1=0; always render PageHeader consistently across empty, permission, and error states.

Lesson learned: Running two Vitest fork shards concurrently with ESLint on Windows caused forks worker startup timeouts; running Vitest shards sequentially with --maxWorkers=2 and TEMP under scratch/ passes cleanly (175 files, 1,035 tests).
